title: 第145章 每个人都有名分第144章 你得给我个名分
slug: 加入合欢宗后师妹的鱼塘炸了
content_zh:
第145章每个人都有名分
云洛脑子一下迟钝了。
“名分？”
她嘴里含糊不清咀嚼这两个字，下意识反问：“你不是嫡长夫吗？”
空气陡然安静，六个男人里，只有一人脸上有笑容。
沈栖尘立刻昂首挺胸，拽得跟二五八万似的。
他抬高下巴，眉毛微挑，趾高气扬对着几人道：
“听到了吗？阿洛说得很清楚，我是嫡长夫，应该不用她再重复一遍吧。”
“凭什么？”夜缙黎看不得他嘚瑟，“阿洛，我不同意，他一个勾栏样式的三，既不端庄，也不兄友弟恭，哪里担得了大房。我觉得，我就比他好。”
他拍着胸膛，颇有自荐的意思。
云洛张了张嘴，要说什么，裴砚清上前一步，低头，清冷的眸中委屈。
“阿洛，是我哪里不如沈弟吗？”
他不太会像沈栖尘那样又争又抢，但他感觉，云洛对他是有偏爱的。
这种偏爱，让他觉得自己一定是特殊的。
就算是不争不抢，也能稳坐大房之位。
但云洛却突然当着他们的面承认，死绿茶是她钦点的嫡长夫。
他眸光落寞，心里反思，自己是哪里还做得不够好。
“阿洛，不要不要。”
涂山鄞从身侧抱着她，大耳朵在她脸上蹭。
“沈兄不合适，正宫是要能管住所有人的，我是妖皇，我来当最合适了。”

夜缙黎不同意了：“你是妖皇，我还是魔神呢，我底下的人全都听我的。”
玄承叉腰附和：“就是，狐兄，你虽是妖皇，但大多时候，都是你族中长辈在帮你打理吧。”
说完，话锋一转：“阿洛，你现在的实力，又不需要依仗谁，正室当然要选自己最喜欢的，你不昨日才说最喜欢我吗？那当然选我。”
云洛欣慰又无奈。
单纯的小黑龙，也学会又争又抢了。
“阿洛才不最喜欢你。”凌熠一双大翅膀噗地从背后展开，“丈夫的容貌，妻子的荣耀，阿洛的正夫，当然是要最漂亮的，你们那么丑，都没资格和我抢。”
“扁毛，说谁丑呢！”
沈栖尘撩起袖子，上前要和人好好理论，但刚走了两步，不服他的夜缙黎站出来。
“狗东西，咱们先打一架吧，谁赢了谁当老大。”
话落，两人就扭打在一块。
今日是来决出谁是老大的，他俩打起来哪儿还有结果。
裴砚清蹙眉上前，结果夜缙黎的拳风就擦着他的脸过，再然后，他也被拉进了战场。
涂山鄞、玄承和凌熠相视一眼，很快也加入了战斗。
六人实力相差悬殊，沈栖尘和夜缙黎也算讲武德，没斗法，只靠原始的肢体动作，你一拳我一拳互殴。
刚刚剑拔弩张的气氛一下乱成了一锅粥。
云洛头疼扶额，实在看不下去，一抬手，神力硬生生将六人震开，谁也动弹不得。
“行了，都别打了。”
六人被她强行站成了一排，她走到沈栖尘面前，道：“我既然说了你是嫡长夫，那就不会有变，就这么说定了。”
沈栖尘眼角有一点淤青，听到此，桃花眼荡开笑意，那点伤，反而成了他胜利的勋章。
“阿洛果然最宠我。”

但另外五人哪儿能乐意，异口同声表示不服气。
第145章每个人都有名分
“阿洛，不……”
“嘘！”

Chapter 145 Everyone has a destiny
Yunluo's mind suddenly became dull.
"Name?"
She chewed the two words in her mouth vaguely, and subconsciously asked, "Aren't you the eldest husband?"
The air suddenly became quiet, and only one of the six men had a smile on his face.
Shen Qichen immediately held his head high and raised his chest as if he was worth 2,580,000 yuan.
He raised his chin, raised his eyebrows slightly, and said to several people arrogantly:
"Did you hear that? Aluo made it very clear that I am the eldest husband, so she shouldn't need to repeat it again."
"Why?" Ye Jinli couldn't bear to see his arrogance, "Aluo, I don't agree. He is a threesome with a check-bar style. He is neither dignified nor brotherly. He can't afford a big house. I think I am better than him."
He patted his chest, quite suggesting himself.
Yun Luo opened his mouth to say something, but Pei Yanqing took a step forward, lowered his head, and looked aggrieved in his cold eyes.
"A Luo, am I not as good as Brother Shen?"
He wasn't very good at fighting like Shen Qichen, but he felt that Yun Luo had a preference for him.
This kind of preference made him feel that he must be special.
Even if you don't fight for it, you can still sit firmly in the big house.
But Yunluo suddenly admitted in front of them that Shi Green Tea was her appointed eldest husband.
His eyes were lonely, and he reflected in his heart on what he had not done well enough.
"Arlo, no, no, no."
Tu Shan Yin hugged her from his side and rubbed his big ears against her face.
"Brother Shen is not suitable. The main palace must be able to control everyone. I am the Demon Emperor, so I am the most suitable one."
Ye Jinli disagreed: "You are the Demon Emperor, and I am still the Demon God. All the people under me listen to me."
Xuancheng chimed in with his hands on his hips: "That's right, Brother Fox, although you are the Demon Emperor, most of the time, the elders in your clan are helping you take care of things."
After saying that, the conversation changed: "Aluo, with your current strength, you don't need to rely on anyone. Of course you have to choose the one you like best as your wife. Didn't you just say you like me the most yesterday? Of course you choose me."
Yunluo was relieved but helpless.
The simple little black dragon also learned to fight and rob.
"Aluo doesn't like you the most." Ling Yi spread out a pair of big wings from behind, "A husband's appearance, a wife's glory, of course Aluo's real husband must be the most beautiful. You are so ugly, you are not qualified to compete with me."
"Bianmao, who are you calling ugly!"
Chen Qichen rolled up his sleeves and stepped forward to argue with the person, but as soon as he took two steps, Ye Jinli, who was dissatisfied with him, stepped forward.
"Bitch, let's have a fight first. Whoever wins will be the boss."
As soon as the words fell, the two of them started fighting.
Today is to decide who is the boss. There will be no outcome if they fight.
Pei Yanqing frowned and stepped forward, but Ye Jinli's fist brushed his face, and then he was also pulled into the battlefield.
Tu Shan Yin, Xuan Cheng and Ling Yi looked at each other and quickly joined the battle.
The strength of the six people is very different. Shen Qichen and Ye Jinli can be regarded as martial arts and have no fighting skills. They only rely on primitive body movements. You punch and I punch each other.
The tense atmosphere just now turned into chaos.
Yun Luo held his head against his head because he couldn't stand it anymore. He raised his hand and his divine power forcefully shook the six people away. No one could move.
"Okay, don't fight anymore."
She forced the six of them to stand in a row. She walked up to Shen Qichen and said, "Since I said you are the eldest husband, there will be no change. It's settled."
There was a little bruise at the corner of Chen Qichen's eye. Hearing this, his peach-blossom eyes smiled, and that injury became a medal of his victory.
"Aluo really loves me the most."
But how could the other five be happy? They expressed their dissatisfaction in unison.
